annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
key_provisions_or_claims: Extends transitional period for legacy-directive medical devices to 31 December 2027 (class III, IIb implantable) and 31 December 2028 (other classes).
Conditions: continued compliance, no significant design changes, no unacceptable risk, QMS by 26 May 2024, application to notified body by 26 May 2024.
Notified body agreement required by 26 September 2024, with surveillance transferred to the MDR notified body.
Class III custom-made implantable devices may be marketed without notified body certificate until 26 May 2026.
Removes the time limit on making available devices already in the supply chain.
annotation.summary_en: EU Regulation 2023/607 amends the Medical Devices Regulation (2017/745) and IVDR (2017/746) to extend transitional periods for legacy-certified devices, staggered by risk class, to avoid shortages while maintaining safety. It sets conditions for the extension and shifts surveillance to MDR notified bodies. It has no AI or robotics content.
annotation.title_clean: Regulation (EU) 2023/607 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 15 March 2023 amending Regulations (EU) 2017/745 and (EU) 2017/746 as regards the transitional provisions for certain medical devices and in vitro diagnostic medical devices
